answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the opal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the summit of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the kernel re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
